chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Affection of the fathers creates a relationship between the sons, and the relationship is more in need of affection than affection is of relationship.
ai.seo_question: How does paternal affection influence the relationship between sons according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In this maxim from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the dynamic nature of kinship (*qarabah*), asserting that it is not merely a static biological link but a relationship sustained by active affection (*mawaddah*). This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on *silat al-rahim* (maintaining ties of kinship) as a spiritual obligation that requires continuous emotional investment to prevent the erosion of familial bonds.
